finalText:
**Redis died, and the app never recovered.** One root cause, not many.

At `02:14:07` `Redis` at `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections. The cache fell back to direct store reads. That triggered a cache miss storm, then `TimeoutError` after 5000ms on every worker. Queue depth climbed from 52 to 568 and passed the 500 cap at `02:29:12`. At `02:31:44` `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory`. The supervisor killed the process group at `02:31:52`.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Last good request | `02:14:03` [logs/app.log:181](logs/app.log:181) |
| Reconnect tries | 13, all `ECONNREFUSED` |
| Retry gap | fixed 80s, no backoff |

Next: check why `Redis` at `10.0.0.12` went down. The retry loop needs backoff and the queue needs a hard cap.
